verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own docs say access can be scoped with roles down to the table and column level, with SSO through your own identity provider. That covers the role, table and column parts of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions row-level policies or masking policies, and only a single marketing line backs any of it. Missing for 10: row-level security, column masking policies, in-depth docs on the role/grant model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
